stages.title: Define audience and positioning
stages.description: Decide who the product is for and why they should care, before any launch material is written.
tasks: Interview 5-10 people from the target audience
List the top 3 alternatives and how we differ
Pick one launch goal and its success metric

stages.title: Finalize the product
stages.description: Freeze the scope that ships on launch day and make sure it works end to end.
tasks: Add analytics for the key events

stages.title: Landing page and docs
stages.description: The place every launch link points to: one page that explains, convinces and collects signups.
tasks: Build and deploy the landing page
Add a signup or waitlist form
Check mobile layout and page speed

stages.title: Launch assets
stages.description: Everything that is published on launch day, prepared in advance.
tasks: Record screenshots and a short demo video

stages.title: Closed beta
stages.description: Let a small group use the product for real and fix what hurts most.
tasks: Triage and fix the top issues

stages.title: Outreach and communities
stages.description: Line up the people and places that will see the launch.
tasks: Pick 5 communities and channels to post in
Ask supporters to be ready on launch day

stages.title: Launch readiness check
stages.description: Last look before going public: nothing should surprise you on launch day.
tasks: Test the full path from signup to payment
Check the support inbox and FAQ

stages.title: Launch
stages.description: Go public and stay close to the first users.
tasks: Answer comments and support requests all day
